Kids Bible Class · August — Week 4

God Knows Everything About Me

Psalm 139:1-4; Matthew 6:26; 10:30, 42

“How you made me is amazing and wonderful.”

Psalm 139:14 (NIrV)

God knows everything about you and still loves you completely.

Image 1

God knows you better than anyone in the whole world.

He knows when you wake up and when you lie down to sleep.

Image 2

God even knows your thoughts and your words —

before you ever say them out loud!

Image 3

God knows every little thing about you.

Jesus said God even knows the number of hairs on your head!

Image 4

Jesus said God takes good care of the little birds.

And you matter to God even more than the birds do.

Image 5

There is nothing about you that God doesn't know.

He knows everything — and He loves you completely.

You are always seen, always known, always loved.

What We Learn

God knows everything about you — your thoughts, your words, even the number of hairs on your head. He cares for the little birds, and you matter to Him even more. Nothing about you is hidden from God, and He loves you completely.

For you: You never have to feel alone or unknown. God sees you, understands you, and loves every part of you — all the time.
